title: QOLpack
description: Adds a few cool features and boosts FPS (by a little bit due to the modpack size).
body:
# QOLPack A semi-light modpack that adds a few cool features and boosts FPS by a bit. ## -- MANDATORY MODPACK DESCRIPTION -- This modpack adds player heads in chat, a few QOL features, a few FPS booster mods (e.g, Sodium, ImmediatelyFast, ETC.), as well as a minimap and waypoints system (via Xaero's Minimap). This is NOT perfect, and I may improve the modpack to allow for more FPS to be gained. Use this modpack when you want FPS, but also some features that make playing Minecraft just a tiny bit more convenient. ## Supported Hardware: I'm not exactly sure, but for a good estimate, check [Sodium's hardware compatibility section.](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) ## Hardware that has been tested: Dell G3 15 (GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 TI, CPU: Intel I5-9300H, 16GB RAM.)
**I honestly expect this to never get any traction, but if you use this modpack, and you like it, share it with a friend. :D**
